aboutSubheading: Your local building partner from concept to completion
aboutText: EJ Building Group has been proudly serving South East Melbourne for over 15 years, specialising in home extensions, renovations and refurbishments. Our experienced team of licensed builders understands the unique character of homes across Frankston, Dandenong, Cranbourne and the surrounding suburbs. We're committed to delivering quality craftsmanship, transparent communication and projects that are finished on time and on budget.
fullWidthImageAlt: Aerial view of a beautifully renovated Melbourne suburban home
servicesSubheading: Professional building solutions tailored to your home and lifestyle
servicesText: From single-room refurbishments to multi-storey extensions, EJ Building Group offers a complete range of residential building services. Every project starts with a thorough consultation to understand your goals, budget and timeline.

services.title: Home Extensions
services.desc: Need more space? We design and build seamless home extensions that blend perfectly with your existing property — whether it's an extra bedroom, a second storey or a sunroom.

services.title: Renovations
services.desc: Transform your kitchen, bathroom or entire living area with our full renovation service. We manage everything from demolition to the final coat of paint.

services.title: Refurbishments
services.desc: Restore and modernise your home's interior and exterior with our refurbishment solutions, including new flooring, cladding, plastering and structural repairs.

services.title: Project Management
services.desc: We coordinate trades, permits and suppliers so you don't have to. Our dedicated project managers keep your build running smoothly from day one.

services.title: Structural Repairs
services.desc: Cracked walls, sagging floors or termite damage? Our team carries out expert structural assessments and repairs to keep your home safe and sound.

services.title: Outdoor Living Spaces
services.desc: Enjoy Melbourne's warmer months with a custom-built deck, pergola or alfresco area designed to complement your home and lifestyle.

bannerSubheading: Let EJ Building Group bring your dream home to life. We handle every detail so you can enjoy the process.
